title: feat(checks): turn 13 real CodeRabbit Majors into pre-PR checks, each proven on the commit that had the bug
body:
CodeRabbit keeps finding the same kinds of Major in our PRs: a GraphQL connection read without pageInfo, a handler that awaits before its lock, a path scrubber that leaks one shape of path, a state the tests never paired with an event. Each was fixed once, and nothing stopped the next one. This PR turns 13 of those real Majors into checks that run before a PR opens and in CI, and proves each check against the commit that had the bug.

What is in it:

1. **Proof harness** (`scripts/checks/prove-check.mjs`, `proofs.json`). Each row names a Major, its pre-fix SHA and its fix SHA. The harness builds both trees with `git archive`, runs the check in each, and passes only when the check fires at pre-fix and stays quiet at the fix. A crashed run, a Semgrep run with no JSON, or an import error is BROKEN, never a pass. A Semgrep row can tie a hit to its source line (`fireText`), so a fix that only moves the line does not pass.
2. **Semgrep pack** (`scripts/ratchets/semgrep-ccv3/`, 3 rules from Majors #44, #64, #38) run as a ratchet in Docker at a pinned image digest. Baseline: 0 rule findings, 2 accepted scan-error keys.
3. **Path scrubber grid** (`apps/agentic-os/e2e/safe-message-invariant.spec.ts`): every root x segment x wrapper shape. It found 153 leaking cases on main; `safe-message.ts` now scrubs all of them.
4. **Next steps corpus**: every input the Next steps parser got wrong, kept in one test.
5. **State x event tables** T1 (agent status), T2 (review-router ready events), T3 (grant against a kept decline), with a completeness check so a missing cell fails a test.
6. **review-status.mjs**: the PR body edit history now asks for pageInfo (the #64 shape). A body with more than 20 edits stays NOT READY, and the reason now says so.
7. **pr-checkpoint**: a Yes in the side pane on a round ask now keeps a decline it does not cover, the same rule as the typed grant command.
8. **CI** (`.github/workflows/ccv3-checks.yml`): the new checks run on every PR.

Decisions from Dave (2026-11-01): D1 fix the body edit history here; D3 fail closed; D-a pane Yes follows the grant rule; D-b keep more than 20 body edits NOT READY; D-c accept the 2 scan-error baseline keys.

## Evidence

Proof type: feature

RED: `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config apps/agentic-os/playwright.pure.config.ts --reporter=list` @ 3a2a8174
```text
Running 548 tests using 1 worker
  153 failed
  395 passed (3.9m)
```

GREEN: `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config apps/agentic-os/playwright.pure.config.ts --reporter=list` @ 455d48fa
```text
  916 passed (9.7s)
```

Artifacts: `.claude/cache/e2e/2026-11-01-prA-red-scrub-grid.txt`, `.claude/cache/e2e/2026-11-01-prA-green-scrub-grid.txt`.
Proofs at the fire/no-fire SHAs, all rows pass: `node scripts/checks/prove-check.mjs --check c1` 5/5, `--check c2` 3/3, `--check c5` 7/7 (`.claude/cache/e2e/2026-11-01-prove-c1.txt`, `-prove-c2.txt`, `-prove-c5-final.txt`).
Also green: `node scripts/ratchets/semgrep-ccv3.mjs` (new 0, drift 0), `node scripts/mods/validate-mods.mjs` (tsc OK, 1303 pass 0 fail), `node --test` over prove-check, semgrep-ccv3 and review-status tests (304 pass 0 fail).

CodeRabbit round 1 (8 findings: 4 Major, 4 Minor), all fixed with a failing test first:
- `34701f70`: two scrubber leaks (an inner quote taken as the closing quote; an apostrophe then a space) and the flaky 100 ms timing bound. Grid RED 91 failed, GREEN 914 passed.
- `5c218dbc`: Semgrep rules mounted by a joined path (`{rules}`), proof trees cleared before each run, a runnable state-table cell needs `expect`, R14 expects the request text. Proofs c1 5/5, c2 3/3, c5 7/7 (`.claude/cache/e2e/2026-11-01-pr243-r2-prove-c*.txt`).
- `1e222f7a`: the PR body edit history is read page by page (cap 2020 edits), so more than 20 edits no longer blocks READY. RED 6 failed, GREEN 327/0.
Gates at 1e222f7a: node tests 387/0, validate-mods 1323/0 (tsc OK), Semgrep ratchet new 0.

CodeRabbit round 2 (paid, 2 Minors), fixed with a faili
